title: The status pill keeps the saved status while another is picked
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PILLKEEP-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • Inactive part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PILLKEEP-02) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab, type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click the Inactive option.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Type {Part-B} in the search.
  7. Click the {Part-B} row.
  8. Click the Active option.
  9. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the title row pill still reads "Active" in green.
  • Step 8: the title row pill still reads "Inactive" in grey.
  • Steps 4 and 9: the window closes without saving.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R25, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.2 (Inactive picked), board 3.7 (Bringing it back), 13 Oct copy.
